description: This file is an HTML webpage that includes embedded Ruby code for a CodeMirror mode demonstrating Ruby syntax highlighting and providing an interactive Ruby code example. It contains HTML structure, CSS styles, JavaScript dependencies, and a code snippet showcasing Ruby programming, notably a polynomial evaluation program.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element, with mode set to Ruby and match brackets enabled.
